# Predicting the next scene is not the same as acting or preserving a world

[简体中文](../../../../learning/deep-dives/multimodal-models/world-state-actions.md) · English

Updated 2026-11-11 · 25 topic entries / 9 representative comparisons

World models must separately show what state retains, how actions alter futures, how plans are evaluated, and how memory persists across segments. LeWAM and V-JEPA Policy connect prediction and actions; prediction–planning evaluation decomposes errors; WOVEN supervises visual transitions; PPMem maintains geometry; VBVR-Pro executes task checks. SWIM learns relative state-coordinate weights from offline action predictability to shape latent distances without giving deployment planners real future states.

[Mechanisms](#comparison) · [Trade-offs](#analysis) · [Cross-paper questions](#questions) · [Updates](#updates)

!!! note "How to read this card"

    The table compares representative methods. It is not a shared-benchmark leaderboard. Teaching examples are not measured results.

## Trade-off analysis {#analysis}

### Readable state, predictable futures, and successful action are separate checks

LeWAM jointly shapes vision with control and prediction; V-JEPA Policy learns prediction/actions on frozen vision. Either way, test if latents retain physical state, how much additional error prediction adds, and whether planning succeeds. A common physical decoder separates the first two; planning is run independently rather than inferred from latent loss.

Sources: [LeWAM: End-to-End World and Action Modeling with JEPAs](../../../../reproductions/2610.12818-lewam/README-en.md) · [V-JEPA Policy: Building Effective World-Action Models on Predictive Visual Latents](../../../../foundation-models/2609.37250-vjepa-policy/README-en.md) · [One-Step Prediction Fidelity Is a Poor Proxy for Planning Performance in JEPA World Models](../../../../foundation-models/2610.19375-jepa-prediction-planning/README-en.md)

### Generating plausible transitions and verifying consistency need separate interfaces

WOVEN supplies generated video transitions whose visible changes must actually supervise learning instead of revealing outcomes in prompts. PPMem preserves geometry across chunks and views; future camera paths do not reveal real future frames. VBVR-Pro checks executable constraints, but a scorer does not train a capable generator. These are data, memory, and verification respectively.

Sources: [WOVEN: Weaving Visual World Modeling into Multimodal LLMs](../../../../reproductions/2610.12417-woven/README-en.md) · [Persistent Planar Memory for Video World Models](../../../../foundation-models/2610.23795-ppmem/README-en.md) · [VBVR-Pro: A Scalable and Verifiable Suite for Native Visual Reasoning](../../../../reproductions/2608.26105-vbvr-pro/README-en.md)

### October 29: new method and evidence boundary

GUI-JEPA predicts residual successors in current screen latents and combines action-specific ROI/global regions and structural cosine scores. This differs from pixel-video supervision and actual GUI execution. The component receives external frozen latents and text matching scores, retains a trained three-layer predictor and head, and does not use positive training labels to choose actions in forward inference.

Sources: [LeWAM: End-to-End World and Action Modeling with JEPAs](../../../../reproductions/2610.12818-lewam/README-en.md) · [GUI-JEPA: Candidate-Conditioned JEPA Latents as a Fast Action Policy for Mobile GUI Agents](../../../../foundation-models/2610.36877-gui-jepa/README-en.md)

### Behavior can shape geometry without becoming a future-state oracle

GUI-JEPA predicts candidate-conditioned latent residuals and learns listwise decision scoring. SWIM uses offline action chunks to learn which state displacements predict those actions, then freezes continuous gates as supervision for latent geometry. Neither latent check establishes execution. SWIM's h changes future-state spacing, not the fixed current action chunk. Inverse dynamics and true future states stay out of planning; coordinate standardization after `sqrt(g)` cancels the weights.

Sources: [SWIM: Learning What Matters from Behaviors for JEPA World Models](../../../../foundation-models/2610.36662-swim/README-en.md) · [GUI-JEPA: Candidate-Conditioned JEPA Latents as a Fast Action Policy for Mobile GUI Agents](../../../../foundation-models/2610.36877-gui-jepa/README-en.md)

### JEPA representation alignment and a world-action loop require different supervision

RS-JEPA aligns registered sensor images and scan views for retrieval. Its adversarial partitions and neighborhood loss describe relationships among current scenes, not action-conditioned state transitions merely because its name includes JEPA. V-JEPA Policy freezes a pretrained encoder and trains a future-latent predictor and action expert, requiring separate action/environment validation. Remote-sensing F1@5, latent prediction error and robot success cannot be combined into one score.

Sources: [RS-JEPA: Remote Sensing Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture with Scan-Path Views for Cross-Sensor Image Retrieval](../../../../multimodal-models/2611.14496-rs-jepa/README-en.md) · [V-JEPA Policy: Building Effective World-Action Models on Predictive Visual Latents](../../../../foundation-models/2609.37250-vjepa-policy/README-en.md)

## Cross-paper questions {#questions}

Try answering before expanding the explanation. Each question relates at least two papers.

### Do LeWAM and V-JEPA Policy differ only in their visual backbone? {#cross-frozen-versus-joint-encoder}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** No. LeWAM jointly updates encoder, dynamics, and policy with online targets; V-JEPA Policy freezes pretrained vision and detaches future targets. Whether control gradients shape vision and whether targets move are different training contracts.

    **Illustrative example:** Grasping supervision can adjust vision in the joint path, while the frozen path mainly changes prediction and action modules.

    Sources: [LeWAM: End-to-End World and Action Modeling with JEPAs](../../../../reproductions/2610.12818-lewam/README-en.md) · [V-JEPA Policy: Building Effective World-Action Models on Predictive Visual Latents](../../../../foundation-models/2609.37250-vjepa-policy/README-en.md)

### Does lower JEPA prediction error show LeWAM candidate planning beats a reactive policy? {#cross-low-prediction-loss-not-planning}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** No. Prediction error mixes latent readability and added dynamics error; plans also depend on action candidates, accumulation, and goals. Decode with the same physical head to separate errors and test planning independently. Local non-holdout LeWAM did not observe an advantage.

    **Illustrative example:** Predicting a static scene accurately does not choose actions that reach a target.

    Sources: [One-Step Prediction Fidelity Is a Poor Proxy for Planning Performance in JEPA World Models](../../../../foundation-models/2610.19375-jepa-prediction-planning/README-en.md) · [LeWAM: End-to-End World and Action Modeling with JEPAs](../../../../reproductions/2610.12818-lewam/README-en.md)

### Which of WOVEN's videos, PPMem's geometry, and VBVR-Pro's scorer guarantees correctness? {#cross-rollout-memory-verifier}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** They serve different roles: action-conditioned transition data, persistent memory, and executable checks. Realistic video does not guarantee a valid transition, stored geometry can err, and scores cover only defined rules. Verify data, state maintenance, and scoring independently.

    **Illustrative example:** Memory may preserve object position at an old viewpoint, but counting and ordering require their own validation.

    Sources: [WOVEN: Weaving Visual World Modeling into Multimodal LLMs](../../../../reproductions/2610.12417-woven/README-en.md) · [Persistent Planar Memory for Video World Models](../../../../foundation-models/2610.23795-ppmem/README-en.md) · [VBVR-Pro: A Scalable and Verifiable Suite for Native Visual Reasoning](../../../../reproductions/2608.26105-vbvr-pro/README-en.md)

### Why isn't a GUI-JEPA successor prediction a successful action verified on a phone? {#cross-oct29-method-boundary}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** A learned latent can omit real state constraints. Success needs environment feedback; small latent forward passes, candidate permutation equivariance, and gradients verify only the module.

    **Illustrative example:** A predicted page vector near the target does not show that a real button was clickable or the request succeeded.

    Sources: [LeWAM: End-to-End World and Action Modeling with JEPAs](../../../../reproductions/2610.12818-lewam/README-en.md) · [GUI-JEPA: Candidate-Conditioned JEPA Latents as a Fast Action Policy for Mobile GUI Agents](../../../../foundation-models/2610.36877-gui-jepa/README-en.md)

### Why may neither SWIM nor GUI-JEPA give a real successor state to a deployment policy? {#cross-swim-training-future-not-planning-oracle}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** `q(t+h)` is offline supervision for SWIM inverse dynamics and gating; only weighted latent geometry transfers to image-based planning. GUI-JEPA likewise predicts rather than observes candidate successors. Real successors would turn the evaluation into an oracle.

    **Illustrative example:** Offline future frames can label displacements, but action selection cannot see those answers. Varying h also does not stretch the fixed five-frame action target across the entire h interval.

    Sources: [SWIM: Learning What Matters from Behaviors for JEPA World Models](../../../../foundation-models/2610.36662-swim/README-en.md) · [GUI-JEPA: Candidate-Conditioned JEPA Latents as a Fast Action Policy for Mobile GUI Agents](../../../../foundation-models/2610.36877-gui-jepa/README-en.md)

### Does consistent cross-sensor neighborhoods in RS-JEPA establish action planning? {#cross-retrieval-jepa-not-action-policy}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** No. They constrain registered-image retrieval representations and similarities to other scenes, without defining action-conditioned dynamics or a policy output. V-JEPA Policy adds a future predictor and flow-matching action expert. Passing representation kernels cannot replace environment-task validation.

    **Illustrative example:** Both sensors ranking similar farmland scenes consistently demonstrates agreement in representation. It predicts neither what a robot will see after moving nor which action it should take.

    Sources: [RS-JEPA: Remote Sensing Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture with Scan-Path Views for Cross-Sensor Image Retrieval](../../../../multimodal-models/2611.14496-rs-jepa/README-en.md) · [V-JEPA Policy: Building Effective World-Action Models on Predictive Visual Latents](../../../../foundation-models/2609.37250-vjepa-policy/README-en.md)

## Update log {#updates}

Updates record new approaches, changed trade-offs, and follow-up evidence.

**2026-11-11** · Added RS-JEPA to distinguish scan views, adversarial partitions and neighborhood consensus from V-JEPA Policy's future/action loop. Preserved shared-trunk stop-gradient rather than momentum targets. These are L1 tensor mechanisms; full Vim/CVA/predictor training and multi-dataset retrieval are not reproduced.

Affected: [RS-JEPA: Remote Sensing Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture with Scan-Path Views for Cross-Sensor Image Retrieval](../../../../multimodal-models/2611.14496-rs-jepa/README-en.md) · [V-JEPA Policy: Building Effective World-Action Models on Predictive Visual Latents](../../../../foundation-models/2609.37250-vjepa-policy/README-en.md)

**2026-10-30** · Reviewed corrected SWIM: distinguish fixed action chunks from h, use ungated current state, cyclic negatives, real gate gradients, and `sqrt(g)` geometry transfer. Compare GUI-JEPA candidate residuals without exposing future training states to planners.

Affected: [SWIM: Learning What Matters from Behaviors for JEPA World Models](../../../../foundation-models/2610.36662-swim/README-en.md) · [GUI-JEPA: Candidate-Conditioned JEPA Latents as a Fast Action Policy for Mobile GUI Agents](../../../../foundation-models/2610.36877-gui-jepa/README-en.md)

**2026-10-29** · GUI-JEPA predicts action-conditioned residual screen successors and uses ROI/global structural cosine scoring, not pixel generation or a real GUI executor. The component takes external frozen latents and text scores, implements the three-layer predictor and head, and does not use positive training labels to make forward choices.

Affected: [GUI-JEPA: Candidate-Conditioned JEPA Latents as a Fast Action Policy for Mobile GUI Agents](../../../../foundation-models/2610.36877-gui-jepa/README-en.md)

**2026-10-27** · Initial version: compared joint and frozen vision for action, prediction versus planning tests, WOVEN transitions, PPMem geometry, and VBVR program scores; screened 22 abstracts and read six papers.
